questions.question: Refer to your answer in (a). Explain how preventive network security mechanisms, such as firewalls, proxy servers, network segmentation and remote access VPN, reduce the attacks that an IDS must later detect, and state the limitation of these preventive mechanisms.

marking_points.point: A firewall controls incoming and outgoing traffic on the network according to predetermined security policies.
marking_points.quote: Control incoming and outgoing traffic on network with predetermined security policies.

marking_points.point: A proxy server improves data security and network performance by acting as a firewall and web filter, sharing connections and caching data.
marking_points.quote: Proxy servers act as a firewall and web filter, provide shared network connections, and cache data to speed up common requests.

marking_points.point: Network segmentation creates boundaries between segments whose computing assets share a common function, risk or role.
marking_points.quote: Boundaries between network segments where computing assets within the segment have a common function, risk or role within an organization.

marking_points.point: A remote access VPN gives individual hosts or clients remote and secure access to the organization network.
marking_points.quote: Provides remote and secure access to an organization network to individual hosts or clients

marking_points.point: These preventive mechanisms cannot stop every intrusion, so the IDS monitors network resources to detect intrusions and attacks that were not stopped by them.
marking_points.quote: Monitors network resources to detect intrusions and attacks that were not stopped by preventative techniques (firewalls, proxy servers, packet-filtering routers, network segmentations)

marking_points.point: The limitation is that preventive mechanisms alone are insufficient, so IDS/IPS is still needed to detect or prevent attacks such as brute force, denial-of-service and exploits of network vulnerabilities.
marking_points.quote: To detect or prevent the network security attacks such as brute force attacks, Denial-of-Service attacks and exploits of network vulnerabilities.
